acceptance.output_evidence: READINGS RECORDED, NO VERDICT OFFERED. (1) WHAT THE ALLOWLIST COSTS: admitting a fourth leaf now requires a source edit, a gate arm, a rebuild, a republish and a five-behavior re-association -- the full B5 deploy path -- because the leaf set lives inside the edge bundle. A prefix rewrite would make a new leaf a pure DATA act (drop the object under platinum/satellites/) with no code motion at all. On a family expected to grow this is a real recurring cost, and this round paid it twice: B2's holdings.json and B4's characteristics.json are two leaves of what is plainly one growing family. (2) WHAT IT BUYS, measured rather than asserted: the refusal branch is the only thing standing between an unknown leaf and a FALSE NEGATIVE one layer down -- shared-advisor-router-response's explicit-empty contract would render an S3 404 as 'this firm has no satellite books', a confident lie rather than an error. The four new gate arms make that concrete: holdings.json.bak, holdings.json/extra, Holdings.json and a ../../ traversal are ALL refused under exact membership and would ALL be admitted and rewritten into non-existent keys under a startsWith or prefix rewrite. (3) THE FAILURE MODES ARE NOT SYMMETRIC: the allowlist fails LOUDLY and inconveniently (a new leaf 404s until someone edits the set); a prefix rewrite fails QUIETLY and plausibly (a typo'd or not-yet-produced leaf renders as an empty book). That asymmetry, not the line count, is what the choice is actually about. (4) A MIDDLE SHAPE EXISTS AND WAS NOT TAKEN, and this worker did not take it because the halves bound the cell to the allowlist: the leaf set could be DATA -- carried in the registry the route already serves, or in a small manifest beside it -- which keeps an explicit CLOSED set (so the refusal branch survives intact) while making a new leaf a publish rather than a deploy. That moves the set's authority from the bundle into an object the same firm boundary already protects. (5) WHAT THIS WORKER WILL NOT ASSERT: whether the family will in fact keep growing. Its size went 1 -> 3 in a single round, which is the only datum available, and two points do not establish a rate.
